measurement: cold complete-request latency for the 1B cube
protocol: parent-observed wall time of fresh processes; 100 launches for ours, 3 for DuckDB (each ~9.5 s); python perf_counter

duckdb_control.query: select g,sum(v),count(*),min(v),max(v) from read_parquet('nyc1b.parquet') group by 1 order by 1
duckdb_control.process: fresh python -c: import + connect + SET threads=1 + execute + fetchall

note: The 1B G=101 variant has a 9,087,844 B index instead of 1,140,168 B; the cold request is dominated by process start-up (1.21 ms of the 1.24 ms), so the index-size difference is within noise. This closes the 'cold 1B cube' evidence gap.
